name: Melanotan II (MT-2)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Melanotan II (MT-2) (MT2) is a cyclic synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Melanotan II (MT-2) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Melanotan II (MT-2) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the MT2 certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 121062-08-6, formula C50H69N15O9, 1024.2 Da).

faq.question: How should Melanotan II (MT-2) be stored?
faq.answer: Melanotan II (MT-2) ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Melanotan II (MT-2)?
faq.answer: Melanotan II (MT-2) is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $125.00; 10–49 kits falls to $115.00 (−8%) and 50+ to $106.24 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
